responsibility: This Texinfo source is the main user manual for GNU Fortran. It organizes and builds the published documentation for invoking gfortran, language and extension semantics, runtime behavior, intrinsic procedures and modules, mixed-language interoperability, and contributor information, and is the top-level document that includes intrinsic.texi and invoke.texi.
same_name_distinction: This is the top-level Texinfo manual for GNU Fortran users and contributors, assembling published documentation and including intrinsic.texi. Unlike gcc/fortran/gfortran.h, it documents the compiler externally rather than defining internal front-end interfaces.
